entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Pulse I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your full name and order number, please?

Thank you, Jane. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 23rd. So I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I just don't like it. It's confusing and generally hard to use. I even read the user manual, which wasn't much help. I guess I just expected more.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear it wasn't what you were hoping for. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment, please.
Okay, thanks for holding. I've checked our policy, and it looks like you're well within our 90-day return window. So, I can definitely process a full refund for you.
Fine. So you'll take it back then?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated that return in our system. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. You can just print that label, put it on the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.

You will. As soon as our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued to your original payment method. That usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
